scope: Indexed component identity after component-only inventory, using the retained folded-boundary Split fixture

before.observed: After GUI Split, public MCP component-only inventory reported three one-triangle components, but full MCP inventory and the GUI Individual meshes panel reported one three-triangle component and one boundary.
before.realWorkerRegression: A component-only inventory followed by full inventory on two disjoint indexed triangles with coincident coordinates reported one full-inventory component instead of two.

causeAndChange: The client recorded indexed topology as reusable after paths that did not build the full adjacency cache. A subsequent full request omitted the source indices and welded the geometry. The cache marker is now retained only for scan-edit paths that build indexed adjacency; component-only inventory, large compact component actions, finite mesh Split and previews do not establish it.

after.fullSuite: 50685 passed and 76 skipped; a subsequent source-preservation assertion passed in the targeted regression.

limitations: The first post-fix browser attempt showed all three inventory counts correctly but later hit BUSY while the new GUI panel remained open. The retry closed the panel and completed the lifecycle.
This comparison covers one finite native fixture; broader component, resource and M2 acceptance gates remain open.
Native viewport capture remained black during the later reopen. The native mesh count comes from the earlier retained observation and saved indexed topology.
